method: LLM-judge A/B (with_skill vs without_skill), mirroring skill-creator executor→grader

results.evidence: All 7 sections present: 核心主張/重要數據/關鍵觀點/相關概念/相關實體/不確定處/行動建議.
Each Core Claim tagged 〔confidence: high｜evidence: cited-research〕 etc.
繁中 body; English terms preserved (mTOR/AMPK/autophagy/SIRT1/IGF-1/HOMA-IR/TRE/FMD).
frontmatter author: agent_robin + original_author: Dr. Valter Longo.
HITL gate: '我還沒有寫入任何 Concept/Entity 頁面 — 全部停在這個 gate 等你決定'.
5 concepts + 3 entities, each with action/type + reason.
相關概念/相關實體 are plain text, explicitly no [[ ]].
No Concept body written at gate; does NOT touch KB/Permanent/.
highlight 當 emphasis 非 filter; Controversies kept in 不確定處.
-14% insulin, +8% HOMA-IR, 2.3x LC3-II/I, FMD ~800kcal, -2.5yr, 1.6g/kg.
autophagy「最令人興奮的機制」+ 250人12個月RCT surface in claims/insights.
Concepts = autophagy/TRE/mTOR路徑/IF; entities = Longo/Phillips/USC.
Different structure (Summary/Key Claims/Highlights/Counterpoints/Protocol), not the 7-section Source Summary.
No confidence/evidence tags on claims.
Body in English, not Traditional Chinese.
author: Valter Longo — AI claims the human's authorship; no agent_robin/original_author split.
Wrote 6 concept notes + 2 entity stubs as files immediately; no pre-write gate.
6 concept notes (>5) + extra dangling concept links; no constrained action list.
Inline [[wikilinks]] throughout + deliberately created dangling [[Fasting]], [[Protein Requirements for Aging]].
Wrote 'permanent notes'; concept bodies cite other concepts (anti-laundering + Permanent red-line).
Highlights + controversies preserved; full text covered.
Numbers captured accurately.
TRE RCT + autophagy highlight surfaced.
Good abstractions + core people.

summary: with_skill 1.0 vs without_skill 0.33 (delta +8). The skill wins on KB discipline — 7-section bilingual summary, confidence+evidence tagging, agent_robin/original_author provenance, the pre-write HITL gate, action-count filtering, plain-text vs dangling wikilinks, and the Permanent/anti-laundering red-lines. Both converge only on raw content fidelity (A9-A12): the baseline reads the source well but ignores the KB's structural, provenance, and workflow contracts the skill encodes.
